title: WHO urges countries to strengthen pandemic preparedness systems
summary: The World Health Organization calls on member states to invest in early-warning surveillance and rapid response capacities to contain emerging infectious disease threats.

title: ILO report: heat stress at work poses growing risk to millions of workers
summary: A new International Labour Organization report finds that rising temperatures are increasing occupational heat-related illness globally, with outdoor and agricultural workers most affected.

title: UNEP: plastic pollution treaty negotiations advance at fourth session
summary: United Nations Environment Programme reports progress in global negotiations toward a legally binding agreement to end plastic pollution by 2040.
